_comment: Daily rotating 'today' news. Deterministic by date hash so all players see the same item on the same day. Mix store-promo, recipe tip, festival reminder, game tip, feature reminder. Items must use ACCURATE info: real game features, real Eastern Market produce in our catalog, no hardcoded weather (live weather is in the brandbar) or hardcoded prices.

items.title_zh: 📦 新功能：仓库 + 卖给东方超市
items.title_en: 📦 New: warehouse + sell to Eastern Market
items.body_zh: 收获的菜先进仓库，要点谷仓卖给东方超市才能换金币。今日首单 +20% 奖励！
items.body_en: Harvested crops go to the silo. Tap the barn to sell to Eastern Market for coins — first sale of the day gets +20% bonus!

items.body_zh: 仓库默认装 20 件，满了就不能再收。先点谷仓卖给东方超市清空，或者花农场币扩建仓库。
items.body_en: Default capacity is 20. When full, harvest is blocked — sell to Eastern Market, or spend coins to expand the silo.

items.body_zh: 韭菜成熟后割掉，茬子会再长出新韭菜，能割 3 次。性价比超高。
items.body_en: Chinese chives regrow after each cut — 3 harvests per planting. Best value/time ratio in the catalog.

items.title_en: 💡 Best for beginners: Shanghai Bok Choy Sprout
items.body_zh: 上海苗只要 5 分钟就熟。新手用它快速升级最划算。
items.body_en: Shanghai bok choy sprout takes only 5 minutes — fastest way for new players to level up.

items.body_zh: 莲藕要长 5 小时，但卖价 C400。睡前种一棵，醒来就能收。
items.body_en: Lotus root takes 5 hours but sells for C400. Plant before bed, harvest in the morning.

items.body_zh: 每天系统挑 3 位真会员当今日邻居，给他们点个赞自己也得 1 积分。
items.body_en: Three real Eastern Market members are picked daily as today's neighbors. Like them — you each earn +1 point.

items.body_zh: Top 10 农场按等级排名，每周一刷新。多种菜往上爬。
items.body_en: Top 10 farms by level, resets every Monday. Plant + level up to climb the ranks.

items.body_zh: 莴笋是东方超市 90 天销量第一。游戏里也能种它哦。
items.body_en: Celtuce is Eastern Market's #1 vegetable over the past 90 days. You can grow it in the game too!

items.body_zh: 耙耙柑是店里水果销量第一，皮软、汁多、超甜。冬春当季。
items.body_en: Papa tangerine is our top-selling fruit — soft skin, juicy, super sweet. Peak season winter-spring.

items.body_zh: 莴笋削皮切丝，热油下蒜末，大火快炒 60 秒，加生抽和糖少许。
items.body_en: Peel + julienne celtuce. Sizzle minced garlic, toss celtuce on high heat for 60 seconds, splash soy + pinch of sugar.

items.body_zh: 热锅冷油下蒜末爆香，下上海青大火快炒 90 秒，几滴生抽，出锅。
items.body_en: Heat oil, sizzle garlic, toss in bok choy on high heat for 90 seconds, splash of soy sauce, done.

items.body_zh: 韭菜切寸段 + 鸡蛋打散，热油先炒蛋盛出，再炒韭菜，合炒 20 秒出锅。
items.body_en: Cut chives into 1-inch pieces, beat eggs. Scramble eggs first + set aside. Stir-fry chives, combine for 20 sec, done.

items.body_zh: 用积分换加速券、装饰品、扩展地块，让农场更丰富。
items.body_en: Spend EP on acceleration tickets, decorations, and plot expansions — make your farm your own.

items.body_zh: 游戏会员登录现在用手机号 + 短信验证码，和店里会员卡同一个账户。
items.body_en: Game sign-in now uses phone + SMS code — same account as your Eastern Market membership.

items.body_zh: 春节窗口开放时，水仙花、年橘等限定作物会出现在种子店。
items.body_en: When the Spring Festival window opens, limited crops like narcissus + kumquat appear in the shop.

items.body_zh: 中秋窗口开放时，芋头、柚子、桂花等限定作物上架。
items.body_en: When Mid-Autumn opens, taro + pomelo + osmanthus become plantable.

items.body_zh: 133-412 Willowgrove Square, Saskatoon。周一至周六 10am-6:30pm，周日休息。
items.body_en: 133-412 Willowgrove Square, Saskatoon. Mon-Sat 10am-6:30pm. Closed Sunday.

items.body_zh: 新鲜蔬菜、调味料、冷冻食品、零食、中药材，2000+ 种应有尽有。
items.body_en: Fresh produce, sauces, frozen, snacks, herbs — 2,000+ items, everything you need.
